lines: Listen. Everyone on the broker's gang owes months. Months are the work we owe. I add more months to the roll for food.
I have read your line, and it has no name on it. What name do I call?

infos.prompt: Put down the name I carry.
lines: We all heard you in the hold. Your line had no name on it, and now it has one.
Take the door up to the plank. The gang walks the shore path, north and west.
You say nothing. I read your line blank again. It has no name on it.
Take the door up to the plank. The gang walks the shore path, north and west.

infos.prompt: Do what you like with your roll.
lines: Ux-Xeek, who calls the names, laughed once and stopped. The gang heard you. Your line stays with no name on it.
Take the door up to the plank. The gang walks the shore path, north and west.

I will say it plainly. Every hand in this gang owes months of work. I hold those months. I hire the gang out to Hereguard Plantation, where the shore path meets the reeds. I add months for food to the roll as well.
Your line on the roll has no name on it. That line is mine to fill or to leave. Wuleen-Sei asks the names for me.
I heard the answer you gave the overseer, Wuleen-Sei. It was enough for her, and it is written. Walk with the gang.

Here is the day's water. Drink what you need and pass the cup to the next hand. I call the names in the hold every day, in order. I have never lost one.
Every hand in this gang owes months of work. Months for food are added to the roll as well, so every meal is counted against the hand who eats it.

infos.prompt: What have the years away cost you?
lines: Two of us in this gang have been kept from the Hist so long that our colour and markings have thinned. Mine is going.

The gang families keep a cutting of the Hist from Nine Bends at the camp. Their egg clutch lies at its roots. I cannot stand beside my own Hist, so I want to stand beside the cutting before my colour is gone.
The camp is where the shore path meets the reeds. You will see the huts, the fire and the hatching shed. The shed stands beside the cutting at the far end.
